title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, NFTs, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong gets behind CLARITY Act ahead of Thursday markup
summary: Armstrong said the bill is "closer than ever" to advancing in the US Congress after months of negotiations between the crypto industry and banks.

title: Senate confirms Kevin Warsh to lead Federal Reserve
summary: The US Senate voted largely along party lines to confirm Kevin Warsh to lead the Fed’s Board of Governors, despite many Democrats’ concerns about the central bank’s independence.

title: Whale shorts $70M in crypto and tech: Should Bitcoin traders worry?
summary: Despite short-term bearish bets from a successful Hyperliquid whale, a growing US Fed balance sheet and rising inflation support Bitcoin in the long term.

title: Polymarket's monthly volume declines for first time since August
summary: Prediction markets trading volume had been tracking monthly gains as the sector gains popularity among short-term traders, but competition is also increasing.

title: Bitcoin traders expect ‘fast move’ to $90K following CLARITY Act vote
summary: Bitcoin traders eye a possible move higher as short-term selling pressure fades and the CLARITY Act vote boosts crypto market focus.

title: Price predictions 5/13: BTC, ETH, BNB, XRP, SOL, DOGE, HYPE, ADA, ZEC, BCH
summary: Bitcoin’s pullback is expected to find support near $79,000, but every recovery attempt is likely to be sold into.

title: Societe Generale deploys stablecoins on Canton for tokenized finance
summary: France's SocGen plans to use its EURCV and USDCV stablecoins for tokenized collateral, repo financing and institutional settlement activity on the Canton blockchain network.

title: US government asks for $1M forfeiture from ex-Celsius exec ahead of sentencing
summary: Former Celsius chief revenue officer Roni Cohen-Pavon, scheduled to be sentenced on Thursday after a guilty plea, agreed to a judgment of $1 million that he obtained as a result of his crimes.

title: Fidelity International launches Moody’s-rated tokenized fund on Chainlink
summary: The Bermuda-based asset manager launched a tokenized liquidity fund using Chainlink and Sygnum infrastructure, with JPMorgan providing daily NAV data for pricing.

title: Tea Protocol announces June 4 mainnet launch and TGE on Aerodrome to secure open-source development in the AI era
summary: This quarter, AI started writing its own exploits. Tea is shipping the trust layer underneath it. Code Is Abundant. Trust Is Not.

title: Traders say Ethereum ready for a 'strong move' after ETH price taps $2.3K
summary: Market analysts eye fresh Ethereum upside, fueled by JPMorgan and BlackRock tokenized fund moves plus looming CLARITY Act catalyst.

title: Bitcoin price targets $79K as US PPI inflation hits highest since 2022
summary: Bitcoin slipped further below the $80,000 mark as US PPI data compounded the inflation problem from the US-Iran war and associated high oil prices.

title: Brickken and Magma partner to deliver Net Asset Value (NAV) oracle for tokenized real estate
summary: Built on Magma's Digital Twin Token (DTT) and Brickken's institutional tokenization infrastructure to close the data gap that has held tokenized real estate back.

title: Paybis secures MiCA, payment licenses in Latvia for EU crypto expansion
summary: Paybis has secured both a MiCA crypto licence and a PSD2 payment institution licence from Latvia’s central bank, becoming the first company in the country to hold both simultaneously.

title: Farage faces UK standards probe over $7M gift from crypto billionaire
summary: UK Reform Party leader Nigel Farage is reportedly facing a probe over an undeclared donation from crypto billionaire Christopher Harborne that he received before becoming an MP in 2024.

title: Metaplanet Q1 profit jumps, but Bitcoin losses hit bottom line
summary: Metaplanet posted strong Q1 operating income driven by Bitcoin options revenue, but swung to a $728 million loss as BTC price declines triggered valuation markdowns.

title: Bitcoin to $100K in Q2? Strategy’s STRC unlocks potential to buy 3K BTC in two days
summary: Strategy’s potential 3,127 BTC buy this week, alongside falling stablecoin dominance, suggests more capital may enter the Bitcoin market.

title: Coinbase-backed x402 adds batch settlement for AI agent payments
summary: Coinbase-backed x402 adds batch settlement, letting AI agents authorize many small payments offchain before settling them later onchain.

title: Arkham maps Iran central bank wallets after $344M USDT freeze
summary: Arkham’s new map links OFAC‑sanctioned Tron wallets to Iran’s central bank, putting Tehran’s alleged onchain reserves and counterparties in full public view.

title: Bitcoin price history suggests 77% odds of new all-time high within a year
summary: Bitcoin reduces its drop from all-time highs to 35% in a move that sparked new BTC price all-time highs "within a year" on seven occasions in the past.

title: Vietnam eyes Q3 launch for regulated crypto asset market: Report
summary: Vietnam’s deputy minister of finance reportedly said the country is planning to launch its regulated cryptocurrency market in the third quarter of 2026 to answer the growing demand for digital assets.

title: Jane Street slashes Bitcoin ETF holdings, adds Ether funds in Q1 2026
summary: Jane Street cut Bitcoin ETF holdings sharply in Q1 2026, including IBIT and FBTC, while adding at least $82 million in Ether ETF exposure.

title: EToro profits rise as commodities boom offsets crypto trading slump
summary: EToro posted its strongest quarter as a public company, with net income up 37% to $82 million, but crypto trade volumes fell 32% in April.

title: Upexi falls 8% after widened fiscal Q3 net loss
summary: Upexi increased its Solana holdings to 2.5 million, valued at more than $238 million, making it the second-largest listed corporate Solana treasury, behind Forward Industries.

title: Legend becomes latest DeFi app to throw in towel
summary: “The product that wins isn’t the one that explains crypto better, it’s the one that hides it completely,” said CEO Jayson Hobby.

title: Hyperliquid ETF attracts $1.2M inflows in 'very solid' US debut
summary: 21Shares’ Hyperliquid ETF debuted in the US to a “very solid day” of trading, despite volumes being below comparatively buzzy crypto ETF debuts.

title: CFTC backs prediction market Kalshi in appeals court fight against Ohio
summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission has urged the Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals to rule that the agency has jurisdiction over prediction markets.

title: Ethereum community launches security feature to end blind signing
summary: Crypto platforms Ledger, Trezor, MetaMask, Keycard, WalletConnect, Argot and Fireblocks are among the earliest adopters and contributors to Clear Signing, aimed at ending “blind signing.”

title: Kelp DAO eyes reopening withdrawals after rsETH burn
summary: Kelp DAO has burned the exploiter’s tokens and outlined a two-week plan to refill rsETH through Aave’s Recovery Guardian multisig wallet.

title: US banks expect ‘slow, then fast’ shift to digitized finance: Moody's
summary: Traditional financial institutions are actively preparing for a surge in adoption to avoid being caught flat-footed by a sudden shift in market demand, according to Moody’s.

title: AI chatbot Claude helps man recover 5 Bitcoin after finding old seed phrase
summary: The crypto investor made Claude search through two Macs, two external hard drives, an Apple Notes export, iCloud Mail, Gmail inbox and X messages to help retrieve the Bitcoin.

title: Only 4% of Americans weigh crypto when placing their votes: Poll
summary: US adults are largely wary of crypto and consider it the least important policy issue when picking who to vote for, according to a poll by POLITICO.
